answer: Read twice (R1, R2), all 73 cases agree; read-backs clean before and after. Ours as built, predicted first (CAP-R2NARROW1280-PREDICTED.json): 68 of 72 fresh, the pasted start (1/2/9/10, text 246.5) as predicted. Narrowing 39 of 40: narrower 19 (to line 7, text 425.7, 12.03 rows' worth) takes 13 rows at the drop, where ours takes the 12 its text needs one pointer step (4.13 px) wider. Fitted on ours' text heights near each end width (a scratch fit, not a rule): at 1280 the drops fit an offset of 1 to 3.5 px, and CAP-TEXTWIDTH and CAP-TEXTWIDTH2 at 1600 fit 4.75 to 6.75 px, so no single offset fits both, in px or as a share of a column. Ours keeps the pointer step. Widening, 3 misses: wider 1, 2 and 7 keep their rows at the drop and fall to what the text needs when let go, as wider 5 does at 1600; no width offset from 0 to 10 px fits them with the other drops. Every let go is as predicted.
